result.instructions: Tools for Bukku, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which sales invoices are overdue, and how much does each customer owe?"; "Show last month's purchase bills from my suppliers."; "Create a draft invoice for Alpha Company Sdn Bhd for 3 hours of consulting at RM 200.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Bukku data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run bukku_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run bukku_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run bukku_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. bukku_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: bukku_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List contacts (customers, suppliers, employees) with name, code, type, receivable and payable balances. Search matches the name, receivable, payable and created date. GET /contacts.

search.description: Keywords in the name, receivable, payable or created date (max 100 characters).

group_id.description: Only contacts in this contact group (see bukku_list_contact_groups).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: bukku_get_contact
tools.title: Get contact
tools.description: One contact with its persons, addresses, tax and registration numbers, default accounts and credit limit. GET /contacts/{id}.

tools.name: bukku_list_contact_groups
tools.title: List contact groups
tools.description: List the contact groups; use their ids to filter bukku_list_contacts. GET /contacts/groups.

tools.name: bukku_list_accounts
tools.title: List accounts (chart of accounts)
tools.description: List ledger accounts from the chart of accounts, optionally by category. Account ids are used on invoice lines. GET /accounts.

search.description: Keywords to search for in the accounts (max 100 characters).

is_archived.description: true to show deactivated accounts instead of active ones (default false).

tools.name: bukku_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: One ledger account by id. GET /accounts/{id}.

tools.name: bukku_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List products and bundles (sales and purchase details, SKU, stock). GET /products.

search.description: Keywords in the name, SKU, sale or purchase description or remarks (max 60 characters).

mode.description: Only products sold or only products purchased.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: bukku_get_product
tools.title: Get product
tools.description: One product with its units, prices, accounts and tax settings. GET /products/{id}.

tools.name: bukku_list_product_groups
tools.title: List product groups
tools.description: List the product groups. GET /products/groups.

tools.name: bukku_list_sales_invoices
tools.title: List sales invoices
tools.description: List sales invoices with number, date, contact, amount, balance and payment status. Filter by date, customer, payment status (PAID, OUTSTANDING, OVERDUE) or keywords. GET /sales/invoices.

date_from.description: Invoices dated on or after this day, yyyy-mm-dd.

date_to.description: Invoices dated on or before this day, yyyy-mm-dd.

status.description: Only transactions with this status. Without it every status except void is returned.

search.description: Keywords in the number, reference, title, remarks, description, contact or billing/shipping party.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: bukku_list_sales_documents
tools.title: List other sales documents
tools.description: List quotes, sales orders, delivery orders, credit notes, customer payments or refunds (invoices have their own tool, bukku_list_sales_invoices). payment_status applies to credit notes, payments and refunds only. GET /sales/{quotes|orders|delivery_orders|credit_notes|payments|refunds}.

payment_status.description: Credit notes (PAID, OUTSTANDING, OVERDUE), payments and refunds (PAID, OUTSTANDING). Not for the other types.

status.description: Only transactions with this status. Without it every status except void is returned.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: bukku_get_sales_document
tools.title: Get sales document
tools.description: One sales document in full (lines, taxes, terms, payments, status): an invoice, quote, order, delivery order, credit note, payment or refund. GET /sales/{type}/{id}.

tools.name: bukku_list_purchase_bills
tools.title: List purchase bills
tools.description: List purchase bills with number, date, supplier, amount, balance and payment status. Filter by date, supplier, payment status (PAID, OUTSTANDING, OVERDUE) or keywords. GET /purchases/bills.

date_from.description: Bills dated on or after this day, yyyy-mm-dd.

date_to.description: Bills dated on or before this day, yyyy-mm-dd.

status.description: Only transactions with this status. Without it every status except void is returned.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: bukku_list_purchase_documents
tools.title: List other purchase documents

GET /purchases/{orders|goods_received_notes|credit_notes|payments|refunds}.

payment_status.description: Credit notes (PAID, OUTSTANDING, OVERDUE), payments and refunds (PAID, OUTSTANDING). Not for the other types.

status.description: Only transactions with this status. Without it every status except void is returned.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: bukku_get_purchase_document
tools.title: Get purchase document
tools.description: One purchase document in full (lines, taxes, terms, payments, status): a bill, order, goods received note, credit note, payment or refund. GET /purchases/{type}/{id}.

tools.name: bukku_list_journal_entries
tools.title: List journal entries
tools.description: List manual journal entries by date, status or keywords. GET /journal_entries.

status.description: Only transactions with this status. Without it every status except void is returned.

search.description: Keywords in the number, reference, title, remarks or description.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: bukku_get_journal_entry
tools.title: Get journal entry
tools.description: One journal entry with its debit and credit lines. GET /journal_entries/{id}.

transaction_id.description: Bukku transaction id of the journal entry.

tools.name: bukku_list_bank_transactions
tools.title: List bank transactions
tools.description: List banking transactions: money in (incomes), money out (expenses) or transfers between accounts. contact_id and sort_by do not apply to transfers. GET /banking/{incomes|expenses|transfers}.

account_id.description: Only transactions on this bank/cash account (see bukku_list_accounts).

contact_id.description: Only this contact (money in / money out).

status.description: Only transactions with this status. Without it every status except void is returned.

search.description: Keywords in the number, reference, title, remarks, description or contact.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: bukku_get_bank_transaction
tools.title: Get bank transaction
tools.description: One money in, money out or transfer transaction in full. GET /banking/{incomes|expenses|transfers}/{id}.

tools.name: bukku_list_tags
tools.title: List tags
tools.description: List the tags (labels) that can be put on transactions. GET /tags.

tools.name: bukku_get_lookup_lists
tools.title: Get lookup lists
tools.description: Reference data needed to fill in documents: tax codes, payment terms, payment methods, currencies, countries, accounts, contact groups, product groups, price levels, tag groups, number formats, custom fields and company settings. Read-only (POST /v2/lists is a read endpoint).

lists.description: Which lists to return, for example ["tax_codes", "terms"].

tools.name: bukku_create_contact
tools.title: Create contact
tools.description: WRITE: create a contact (customer, supplier and/or employee) in Bukku. The contact code must be unique (A-Z, 0-9, _ and -, max 15 characters). POST /contacts.

types.description: Contact types; a contact can be several.

reg_no_type.description: Registration number type; send together with reg_no.

reg_no.description: Registration number. Required for MALAYSIAN_COMPANY (with reg_no_type); individuals need it or tax_id_no.

tax_id_no.description: Malaysian TIN / tax id (11-14 characters). Required for MALAYSIAN_COMPANY; individuals need it or reg_no.

tools.name: bukku_set_contact_archived
tools.title: Archive or unarchive contact
tools.description: WRITE: archive (is_archived true) or restore (false) a contact. Archiving hides it from active lists; nothing is deleted. PATCH /contacts/{id}.

is_archived.description: true to archive, false to unarchive.

tools.name: bukku_create_sales_invoice
tools.title: Create sales invoice
tools.description: WRITE: create a sales invoice for a customer. status defaults to draft (nothing posted to the ledger), status ready finalizes it and affects the books. payment_mode credit needs term_items, cash needs deposit_items. Companies with MyInvois submission switched on must pass myinvois_action when status is ready: NORMAL (not sent), EXTERNAL (already validated elsewhere) or VALIDATE (submits the invoice to LHDN MyInvois, which cannot be taken back). Look up contact, account, term and tax code ids first. POST /sales/invoices.

discount.description: Discount as a value (25.50) or a percentage (10%).

classification_code.description: MyInvois classification code (bukku_get_lookup_lists classification_code_list). Required on every line with myinvois_action VALIDATE.

currency_code.description: Invoice currency, for example MYR. Use the company's home currency unless invoicing in another one.

exchange_rate.description: Rate from the home currency to currency_code. Use 1 when currency_code is the home currency.

term_id.description: Payment term id (bukku_get_lookup_lists terms); the due date is calculated. Give term_id or date.

date.description: Custom due date, yyyy-mm-dd. Give term_id or date.

payment_due.description: Amount due, as a value (100.25) or a percentage (20%).

account_id.description: Account the money was deposited to (bukku_list_accounts).

number.description: Invoice number, blank uses the default number format.

myinvois_action.description: MyInvois handling, only with status ready.
